title: May You Survive
description: A scary horror modpack made for forge 1.20.1
body:
A cool, small modpack that adds a few horror entities to the game! 
Recommended for multiplayer.

<details>
<summary>MOD LIST (SPOILERS)</summary>

Horror Mods List :
- Better Cave Dweller
- From The Fog
- Reverox
- Nyf's Spiders (not really an horror mod, but it can be scary)
- Sanity: Descent Into Madness
- Whisperwoods
- The Anomaly Rephased
- The Knocker
- The Man From The Fog
- The midnight Lurker
- Arthropocolypse

Other gameplay mods :
- Amarite
- Crawl on Demand
- Door Knocker (Forge)
- Essential Mod (for multiplayer purpose)
- JEI
- GraveStone Mod
- Geophilic
- RyoamicLights
- Simple Radio
- Simple Voice Chat
- Many of the YUNG's better smth mods

</details>

Has embedium and some other performance mods

Has Oculus for shaders

I recommend enabling all the texture pack
